theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid m)) (ρ : Euclid m → ℝ) (r ε c : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → (∀ z, ε < ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → (∀ φ : Euclid m → Euclid m, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid m) (r + ε) → (∀ v, ‖φ v‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ v in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid m) (fderiv ℝ φ v).toLinearMap ≤ c) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun v => ∫ z, ρ z * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (v - z)) ∧ ∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid m) r, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun v => ∫ z, ρ z * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (v - z)) v‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c
